2239-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2239-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
2239-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Ardent Elementalist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-3703-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2590-4460-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

2187-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1171-1409-4742.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

277-3293-5413-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
277-3293-5413-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
277-3293-5413-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1336-1636-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1336-1636-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

5670-5708-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-5708-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

3259-3263-5953-6791.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2837-5331-5929.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}.
When Gemcutter Buccaneer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

224-1772-5233-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

856-2034-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-4321-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2178-5173-5686-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-5686-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

957-6333-6334.description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Vanishing by paying {U}{U}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-4779-5263.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Krark-Clan Grunt abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1978-3941-4241.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Karn.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

654-1671-1993-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
654-1671-1993-4222.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

369-1052-5256.notablePrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-1052-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

351-859-2118.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger and Loxodon Warhammer attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
351-859-2118.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3068-3525-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Jenson.
Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
3068-3525-4893.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untaping Jenson.
Repeat.

1166-2796.notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Aristocrat does not have summoning sickness.
1166-2796.description:
Attack with Cephalid Aristocrat.
Pay {0} to Reconnaissance targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Mill 2.
With the trigger on the stack, repeat.

1681-3593-5231.description:
Sacrifice Twilight Shepherd to Thermopod to add {R}.
Twilight Shepherd's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Sacrifice Twilight Shepherd to Thermopod to add {R}.
Twilight Shepherd triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Pay {R} to Sneak Attack to put Twilight Shepherd onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat.

2104-2556-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
2104-2556-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
